title: Generics
summary: Generics keep type safety without ArrayList casts or boxing. This module covers why they exist, generic types versus methods, constraints (class, struct, new(), notnull, unmanaged, Enum, Delegate, allows ref struct), covariance and contravariance versus TypeScript, and a production Result<T> wrapper for cache and API outcomes.

topics.title: Why generics exist (type safety versus ArrayList boxing)
Generic types and methods (open types, closed types, inference)
Constraints on type parameters (class, struct, new(), notnull)
A generic Result wrapper (cache hits, misses, and faults)
